query: How many days of annual leave do I get?
context: Policy HR-07: Full-time employees accrue 25 days of annual leave per year. Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year and must be used by March 31.
groundTruth: 25 days per year; up to 5 unused days carry over and must be used by March 31.
response: Full-time employees accrue 25 days of annual leave per year. You can carry over up to 5 unused days, which must be used by March 31 of the following year.

query: Can I carry over all my unused leave?
context: Policy HR-07: Full-time employees accrue 25 days of annual leave per year. Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year and must be used by March 31.
groundTruth: No. Only up to 5 unused days carry over, to be used by March 31.
response: No. Only up to 5 unused days carry over, and they must be used by March 31.

query: How long is parental leave for a secondary caregiver?
context: Policy HR-12: Primary caregivers receive 20 weeks of paid parental leave; secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks. Leave must start within 12 months of birth or adoption.
groundTruth: 6 weeks of paid leave, starting within 12 months of birth or adoption.
response: Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks of paid parental leave. It needs to start within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

query: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling?
context: Policy FIN-03: Meal expenses while travelling are reimbursed up to 60 EUR per day with receipts. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
groundTruth: Up to 60 EUR per day with receipts; alcohol is not reimbursable.
response: Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 60 EUR per day, provided you keep receipts. Alcohol isn't covered.

query: Does parental leave apply to adoption?
context: Policy HR-12: Primary caregivers receive 20 weeks of paid parental leave; secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks. Leave must start within 12 months of birth or adoption.
groundTruth: Yes; leave must start within 12 months of birth or adoption.
response: Yes. Parental leave applies to adoption as well as birth, and it must start within 12 months of the adoption.
